name: 족과의동침 둘루스
review: We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to 족과의동침 둘루스! The authentic jokbal was truly a delight, and the quality of the ordinary jokbal was excellent – tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. It was definitely the highlight of our meal. The only minor disappointment was the spicy jokbal; while the flavors were good, the meat quality for that dish was noticeably subpar compared to the ordinary jokbal. Despite this, we'd highly recommend it for the classic jokbal experience!
